sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Irish hero Ferchertne, also known as Fercetrniu, served under the heroic king Cú Roí. The king abducted a woman named Bláthnat from the Otherworld, who then conspired with his enemies to cause his demise. In a loyal act, Ferchertne jumped off a Munster cliff with Bláthnat, resulting in both their deaths.

okr.objective: Ferchertne follows his king across a cliff into death.
key_results: He served King Cu Roi as a loyal bard.
King Cu Roi took Blathnat from the Otherworld.
Blathnat plotted with his enemies, and the king died.
The faithful hero leapt from a Munster cliff and pulled her over with him.
